title: The Power of belief -- mindset and success | Eduardo Briceno | TEDxManhattanBeach
summary: Eduardo Briceno gives a TEDx talk on mindset, contrasting fixed and growth views of ability. He argues that believing abilities can be developed encourages challenge, deliberate practice and grit.
why: Recommended as a short, clear explanation of growth versus fixed mindset.

quote.text: I've found this TED talk the best explanation of growth vs. fixed mindset
